Here’s the updated version addressed to both of them:

:::writing{variant="email" id="41726" subject="Thank You Both Again"}
Hey Matt & Amy,

I just wanted to send a quick thank you to both of you for letting us come by and film at Spartan Elite. We always appreciate the opportunity to be in your space and it was great getting to see everyone and check everything out again.

You guys have built an incredible environment over there and we’re excited to continue supporting however we can.

Amy, thank you as well for stepping in and being our fun model for the day. You were awesome and made filming a blast for all of us.

I also wanted to let you both know I’m putting some feelers out for injectors as well. I’m attaching a few resources and materials that we typically provide to the med spas we work with that may help spark some ideas or be useful as you continue growing.

Thanks again for your hospitality and support. Looking forward to staying connected and seeing all the continued growth over there.

Bethany  
Co-Founder & CEO
:::
